integrity: Finite exact Newton determinant identity is reproduced by a standalone Python standard-library verifier, alongside an independent direct graph enumerator for n=3..11. The full theorem requires the written mathematical reduction and integer certificate, rather than empirical extrapolation. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results concern labelled ordinary circular ladders C_n Cartesian K_2 for n>=3, not arbitrary cubic graphs, wider cylinders or independent isolation parameters. Full-size enumerator is a finite transfer expression. Historical priority is provisional because accessible abstracts alone cannot establish all related papers' contents.
title: Six-residue externally supported independence and maximum-set census of circular ladders
